facts.fact: WARDIP-Guinée, under the postal and digital economy ministry, presented at Coyah on 13-14 August 2025 the results of a nine-month feasibility study by the Tunisian firm GTC for a digital addressing system and postcodes for Guinea.
facts.system: digital addressing and postcode system feasibility study
